utterances.text: Okay. Is the generator factory the same thing as the Feros battery factory or the Feros battery factory?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: It's the same thing.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. We'll come back to this map in a minute. But I'd like to ask you about another area. You mentioned that you continued on after the rest of your company had turned off. You continued on with some friends. How many friends was that?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: There were four of us.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Do you remember who they were? Could you give us their names, please.

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Who were they?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Miladin Tadic, Miladin Vuksic, Brano Ilic, and myself.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: I think that first name came in as Miladin Tadic. Is that correct? Is Tadic the first person's last name or is it something else?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Radic. Radic. Miladin Radic, also known as Babaja.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: So it was just the four of you. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: And the others went towards Budak at that first turnoff that you indicated?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Are you sure there weren't more of you who went down passed that turnoff towards Srebrenica?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I'm sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: I mean, there are only 50 or so people in your company, so you will have known if you'd seen some other people from your company down there. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I didn't see anybody else.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: If we could please have that video played. That would be the same video that Mr. Karnavas had requested a short time ago.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Could we please back up for a minute there. Thank you. And if we could move forward. Again, continue to move forward. And If we could stop here.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Mr. Stevic, I would like you to look at not only the armed men along the road, but in the fields behind you'll see that there are some men as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: If we could continue playing the video, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: We can stop there. And, I'm sorry, can we back up a little bit. My apologies to the AV booth. And stop there, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Do you see that group of men in the field in between the first and the second man on the road, if you look back there in the field?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I don't know who they are.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. Now, I'd like to show you, Mr. Stevic, some stills, some pictures taken from this video. And I'd like to begin with page 1 of chapter 12 of an exhibit whose number I'll get in a minute. I'm sorry. I should know that by now. It's Exhibit Number 22. Now, we'll try to go through this relatively quickly, if we could. Now, that person with the number 1 on it, that's your friend Brano Ilic. That's correct, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Number 2, you've already identified yourself there.

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: And number 3 --

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Vuksic. Miladin Vuksic.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Between yourself and Miladin Vuksic, there's someone else. Do you know who that is?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Miladin Bradic.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: I'm sorry, that's Bradic or Radic.

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Radic.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: So those are the four people, those four friends, that you went down towards Srebrenica with. Those are the ones you mentioned. That's correct, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Could we have page 3 from that exhibit placed as well. Mr. Stevic, do you recognise that man with the number 1 over his head?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: He has been identified to the Office of the Prosecutor by one of your friends, Mr. Brano Ilic, as a Miladin Ilic. Does that help you recall who that is?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No. No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: We were told that he is a member of the 2nd Company, 2nd Battalion, same as yourself.

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. So we have this fifth man in addition to your four. Do you see that man with the number 2 over his head?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Do you recognise him?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No, I don't.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Do you know he has also been identified by Mr. Brano Ilic as Mirko Stevic, also a member of your company?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I don't know that.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: If I can please go to the next picture, that would be page 4 from chapter 12 of this exhibit. Before we get to that, Mr. Stevic, Miladin Ilic, do you know who he is? Do you know that name?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No, I don't know it.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: So you don't know if he was in your company or not?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No, I don't. I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Mirko Stevic, do you know that name?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Mirko Stevic, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Was there someone in your company named Desimir Drakula?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Desimir Drakula?

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, he was in the company. But I don't know in which platoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Was there someone in your company with the nickname Krsto?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Was there someone in your company with the nickname Mijo?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: There was more than one Mijo.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. If we could put the next page on there, please, that's page 4, chapter 12 of this exhibit. Do you recognise the person with the number 1 on it?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: That person has been identified by Mr. Ilic as someone nicknamed Krsto who is from your company. Do you recognise number 2?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I don't recognise him, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: The person has already been identified by Mr. Ilic as a member of your company, a Mr. Radic. Do you recognise number 3?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I think that's Ilija Radic.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. Did he have a brother named Dusko?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Was Ilija Radic a member of your company? Do you remember?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes, he was. But he was on sick leave in those days.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Do you recognise the man with number 4 on it?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I don't recall him.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: What about number 5 in the background there?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Both of those have also been identify by Mr. Ilic as members of your company. Now, do you know if -- did you ever find out when you met the rest of the company in Budak, did you ever find out that there had been other people other than the four of you who had been down to -- towards Srebrenica, in the direction of Srebrenica, near Potocari?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. And so -- but you would -- so you haven't heard anything that maybe 10 or 11 of the members of your company did not take that road to Budak, as opposed to four?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: If we can just play that video one last time, and we'll just play the first half of it, please. I'm sorry, I'm finished with the photograph now.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Mr. Stevic, I'd like you to take a look at the other armed persons who are along that road.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: If we could go slow motion here, please. I'm sorry. If we could continue, continue on. And from here, going in slow motion, please, so that Mr. Stevic will have an opportunity to study this screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Mr. Stevic, as you can see, in addition to the people that we've just discussed and that Mr. Karnavas has asked you about, there are other armed people there as well. And we have already mentioned the people in the background in the field.

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I don't know any of them.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Can you keep looking a little further. Okay. Do you recognise any of the people further down there? Perhaps that's too far for you.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: We can stop the video there, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, I don't know any of them.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Mr. Stevic, if there were other members of your company only a few metres further down that road in front of, is it possible that in front of them there were other members of your company?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Objection, it calls for speculation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, I believe so.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay, I'll move on, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Stevic, I'd like to return to this map. But before I do, I'd like to ask you: You said you went 200 metres or so with your three friends past the point where the rest of the company turned off. Did I get that correct?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Now, were there any -- did you see any -- was there buildings or anything around you that you remember the point where you turned around?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Across the road, there was a factory. And that was the battery factory where I turned off.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. You say the battery factory was where the turnoff was towards Budak that the rest of the company took. You also told us you went 200 metres further than that. What I'm asking you is was there a feature or structure or something at the end of that 200 metres as you are going passed that turnoff towards Budak?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: There was nothing, or none that you recall?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: But there were, of course, next to you a line of buses and trucks as you've already explained, as well as a crowd of people. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Now, I'd like you to look at this map one last time. Mr. Stevic, you indicated just to the left of that 91 on the map where you met up with the rest of the company. And first, let me ask you this: Were you admonished in any way for having separated from the rest of the company, the four of you?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Was anyone else admonished in any way for separating from the company?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I didn't hear of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Now, you've indicated where that is. You went past the first turnoff towards Budak, and the rest of the company went on towards Budak as you explained. And you also told us that when you left Zuti Most, you knew -- when you left Zuti Most, you knew where the company was going to gather in the area of Budak. There are two roads here. Why didn't you just take that second road to meet that company? Why did you go back up towards Zuti Most and then turn left towards Budak?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: I didn't understand your question.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Okay. My question is basically this: Why did you turn back to the road that went off to -- why did you turn back north towards Bratunac and turn off towards Budak where the rest of the company had gone? Why didn't you just continue down and then make the right turn, second right turn towards Budak since you already knew where the company was going to meet --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: The second road, yes. My question is: Why didn't you do that?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: But I did go down that second road, and we met up there at Budak. That's where I caught up with them.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Thank you. So you and your three other friends walked all the way down to that second road and then made a turnoff towards Budak. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: And when you were going on this walk, you didn't see those other people that we identified on these photographs, that I identified on that photograph. I'm sorry, on those photographs. Any of the people identified on the photographs turning around. And you didn't come across them as you were walking towards that second road, did you?

utterances.speaker: CVIJETIN STEVIC
utterances.text: No, I didn't.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Thank you very much. No further questions, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Any redirect?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: This cross calls for no redirect, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Well, at this stage, are there any documents to tender? Mr. Karnavas.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. D154, which is the map that the witness marked and testified from.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Any objections, Mr. Shin?

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: No objections, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: This document, the map, D154 is admitted into the evidence. On the part of the Prosecution, are there any documents to tender?

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. It's the -- it's a map marked Prosecution Exhibit 861.1 that has been marked by Mr. Stevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No objections.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. This document is admitted into the evidence. Well, Witness, thank you very much for coming to The Hague to give your evidence. We appreciate it very much. The usher will show you out of the room, and we wish you a pleasant journey back home.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I understand that the Prosecution will file a motion for the amendment of the indictment very soon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. We have been assisted in that matter by getting a deadline for tomorrow, which I intend to meet.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you. And according to the rules, there will be 14 days on the part of the Defence if there are any objections to raise concerning this motion. And I must say that we are proceeding pretty fast. I believe at the end of next week we'll be done over half, more than half of the live witnesses. So I hope the Defence counsel could file their response as soon as possible. I did not set a specific date because it's very difficult to prejudge the contents of that motion yet. We have not seen it at this moment. Could I hear from Mr. Karnavas on that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes, well, it's always comforting that the Prosecution would arrest somebody in 1999, indict them, -- well, indict them first in 1999, arrest them in 2001, go to trial in 2003, and then right before the -- in midstream of the Defence case amend the indictment. It's very comforting to know that the fairness with -- in which the Office of the Prosecution is working. I haven't seen it. I don't know what they intend to do. I understand that the reason that they're amending the indictment is motivated by the Krstic judgement. Once I see it, I'll have a better opportunity to gauge what needs to be done. I take it they will take into consideration some of the factual findings that are in favour of Mr. Blagojevic, and perhaps delete some of those paragraphs that did not belong in the indictment at any point in time. They certainly don't belong right now. But I'll have to wait and see.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Mr. President, I've instructed the people on my team not to respond to Mr. Karnavas's continued comments. And I will try to bite my tongue as well. I think the Court knows the reasons why we're filing the amended indictment, to conform with the law. It doesn't add anything in terms of any substance of significance. It's to conform with the way the genocide law has developed in this Tribunal. And I won't respond to the various comments about how this was -- how this case proceeded. But in any event, I think it is important that something be said so that the public understands that we are conforming with the law as it has been developed, and as I know that the Trial Chamber understood.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: First of all, Your Honour --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Karnavas, we are not going into a debate. We have had already for many, many times.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Very well, just as long as --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I'm just asking you a very simple question and request your cooperation to see if there's any possibility for you to submit your response as soon as possible while recognising that according to the rules you have 14 days to respond. That's a very simple question, you know. We shouldn't go back to this debate.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Very well, Your Honour. As long as my objection to these latter comments are registered. I will do whatever -- the best I can to get it in as expeditiously as possible. I don't intend to play the games that we often see, to take my full 14 days. I will do it as quickly as possible.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much for your cooperation. At this stage, are there any other matters the parties would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, thank you. It seems to me there's nothing. So the hearing's adjourned for this week. We'll meet next week at 9.00, I think in Courtroom I.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
